summary: This 1A Auto tutorial demonstrates two practical methods for assessing tire tread depth across multiple tires: using a digital tread depth gauge and performing a penny test. The host shows how to place a gauge on the tread to quantify remaining life, compares readings across different tires, and explains how to interpret results (including when replacement may be needed). The penny test is demonstrated as a quick visual check, with notes on how to read Lincoln’s head exposure to estimate depth. The video also highlights the importance of checking across the full tread, not just the outer edge, and describes wear patterns influenced by tire inflation and wheel alignment. Throughout, the presenters compare measurements (including values expressed in 32nds of an inch) to determine tire condition and potential safety implications.
title: Tire Tread Depth Check: Gauge and Penny Methods (1A Auto)
